name: SDN Data Retrieval Flow
description: HTTP data-retrieval flow (mount /api/v1/data): foundation/http-route route decides the $HTQ request as a $QRP - "/<code>/bulk" -> "bulk" (any SDS standard: SCHEMA_NAME, SOURCE_NAME, TIME_PROFILE, PROFILE_EPOCH_MS, LIMIT, representation, If-None-Match), "/query" -> "query" (SQL + typed PARAMETERS), anything else -> "refusal" (a $QRP Error straight to the responder); data-source/retrieval omm_bulk resolves the epoch profile (request > config > defaults) and reads storage.flatsql_epoch_stream, data_query runs storage.flatsql_query_stream (typed $PIV hostcalls, capability storage_query; ?profile=all reads every record of the lane through storage.flatsql_query_stream; records are delivered out of band by host body reference - QRP BODY_REF_TOKEN -> $HTR BODY_REF - unless JSON is asked for, then inline), each answering the $QRP request beside a $QRP page (the page header with RECORD_COUNT and the FNV-1a entity tag, then the records verbatim); foundation/http-respond respond_query renders the $HTR (200 / 304 / refusal status): the page stream verbatim as FlatBuffers by default, the records as JSON on request ($OMM). engineLinkage bridge: the retrieval node reaches the store over the storage hostcall bridge; FlatSQL is an independently signed node, never linked into this artifact. foundation/decision-gate and foundation/omm-json are retired: the router's typed ports dispatch and the responder renders the client JSON itself. Typed contracts 1.0: every edge carries one SDS FlatBuffers type; no JSON travels between nodes (JSON exists only as the client representation http-respond renders on request).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Record retrieval served by the data-retrieval flow (wasm; all routing, param parsing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module).

routes.summary: Per-object OMM catalog stream (epoch profile query)
routes.description: Returns one OMM record per object (NORAD_CAT_ID) selected by the requested epoch profile (default: nearest to now), as an aligned size-prefixed $OMM FlatBuffer stream (default) or a bare JSON array (format=json). Conditional GET is supported via ETag / If-None-Match. SCHEDULED FOR DELETION in loop G.6: superseded by the provider-scoped route /api/v1/peers/{peerId}/{standard}/latest.

params.name: epoch
params.description: Target epoch: RFC3339 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) or unix seconds. Default: now.

params.name: profile
params.description: Epoch selection profile (alias: mode; profile wins when both are present). Default: the retrieval module's configured per-standard profile (OMM: nearest).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records returned. Default: unbounded (catalog-sized).

params.name: source
params.description: Restrict to one registered provider source (e.g. celestrak-gp). Default: all sources, provider-latest batch.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of records.

200.description: One $QRP page: the page header (SCHEMA_NAME, FILE_IDENTIFIER, RECORD_COUNT, ETAG, the resolved profile / epoch / limit) followed by the records verbatim. Representation: FlatBuffers by default (?format=flatbuffer or Accept: application/x-flatbuffers); ?format=json or Accept: application/json renders the same record as JSON with the standard's IDL field names (enums by name, byte vectors hex) - rendered by foundation/http-respond, the only place JSON exists.

schema.description: Size-prefixed stream: the $QRP page header, then its record frames (x-sdn-record-count).
The records as a bare JSON array ($OMM only).

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match equals the page ETAG.

400.description: Validation: invalid-profile, invalid-epoch, missing-sql, invalid-params, unsupported-parameter, query-failed.

routes.description: The per-schema form of the bulk read. foundation/http-route matches the SUFFIX "/<code>/bulk" and carries the named SDS standard in query.schema, so the retrieval node — which was always schema-generic — answers $RFB from the same compiled method as $OMM (the route id stays omm_bulk because it is that node's METHOD id in the flow graph). ?format=json is REFUSED here, not mis-encoded: foundation/http-respond renders client JSON for $OMM records only, and $RFB bytes rendered as OMM would answer confident nonsense. A schema-generic JSON encoder node is follow-on work.

routes.summary: FlatSQL query over the record store (flow route)
routes.description: Executes a FlatSQL query and streams the result verbatim as aligned FlatBuffer frames (or a bare JSON array with format=json). Body: JSON {"sql": "...", "params": [...]} or raw SQL text. NOTE: on current hosts the exact path /api/v1/data/query is shadowed by a native auth-gated route (Go mux exact-match precedence); this flow route answers any other path ending in /query under the mount. Superseded by the sandboxed public /api/v1/query (loop G.5).
